title: A user field named value beside the sentinel - the two columns a _value suffix would have fused
rationale: The measurement that turns the central argument of [BL-022] from a paragraph into a standing corpus fact. The entry proposed renaming the sentinel column from the base key to a _value suffix, on the grounds that it would resolve the collision by construction. It would not: joinEncodedKey extends an ALREADY-ENCODED path and does not re-escape it, so a user field literally named `value` produces the segment `value` and the key mixed_value. Under the rename both writes would compute mixed_value and columnFor would hand back the SAME column, fusing element 0's field value with element 1's bare scalar into a single mixed_value=[1,"x"] with no way to tell them apart. This row records that TODAY they are two distinguishable columns and nothing is lost at flatten time.
catchesBugClass: A rename of an encoded column into a namespace that user data already occupies. The flat key set here is the assertion: if anyone implements the _value suffix at either emit site, this row's recorded flat string goes stale and the build turns red before the rename can ship.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the Case 2 form of the same collision - {"data":[[{"value":"A"}],"text"]} takes the nested-array arm, where the loss would come from result.put overwriting rather than from columnFor sharing. MapFlattenerSentinelKeyContractTest measures both arms; only the array-of-maps arm is fixtured here. It also cannot say whether the reconstruct side is right, only that the flatten side has not fused two columns into one.

predicted.detail: PREDICTED, to be replaced by the recorder. Flatten is expected CORRECT: mixed_value=[1,null] beside mixed=[null,"x"], two columns, nothing lost. Reconstruct is expected to REFUSE with KeyCollisionException, because mixed is a leaf key that is also an intermediate path of mixed_value - the same [BL-023] collision, reached from an ordinary user field name rather than from a sentinel. Whether that refusal is DEFECT or ACCEPTED_LOSS is a human call made after the measurement, not before it.
